label: CONCLUSION — VOS-GS final verdict after the full post-PROMOTE protocol (Phases 8-11). All performance numbers MEASURED on EPIC-05 (8x A100-SXM4-80GB, torch 2.9.1+cu128, seed 42); quality numbers MEASURED at 30K final eval (all cameras); exactness per the Phase-5 oracle (in-process, bitwise) and the per-run startup kernel gate.
verdict_scope: SH-only VOS active in iterations 15001-30000 (post-densify region), frozen C0 otherwise untouched.

optimizer_stage_speedup_15k_30k.note: Order-B pairs (VOS-first, GPU-exclusive). Order-A pairs under 3-way co-tenant CPU load deflated the same numbers (room 1.43x) — contention affects the VOS stage's per-iteration host sync, conservative direction.

performance.amdahl_consistency: MEASURED wall gains track the optimizer stage's share of iteration time exactly as the Phase-7 model predicted: room (17% share) +2.5%, garden (27%) +7.9%, bicycle (36%) +10.7%.

exactness.vs_single_tensor_adam_A_s: BITWISE — Phase-5 oracle 7/7 runs (incl. realistic 30K states on all 3 scenes, post-opacity-reset state, 136M+ transitions) + startup kernel gate at every training run (max|dtheta|=0.0, exercised at t~5000 where bc2<1 in f32).
exactness.vs_foreach_adam_A_f: IMPOSSIBLE IN PRINCIPLE — torch's foreach and single-tensor paths differ by <=1 ulp/step on some states (O5b2); confirmed in-training by the A_s attribution run.
exactness.cross_run_trajectories: NOT bitwise reproducible even C0-vs-C0 (backward atomic accumulation order; twin-tested: theta_max_abs ~0.009/0.55 at t=599, final-PSNR spread 0.024-0.092 dB at 30K). Trajectory-level claims therefore rest on quality parity, not bitwise equality.

as_attribution.label: MEASURED — pure torch Adam foreach=False (A_s), NO VOS, room 30K
as_attribution.conclusion: The room PSNR cost is the torch-internal A_f-vs-A_s envelope (<=1 ulp/step, chaotically amplified over 15K iterations), NOT a VOS defect: pure A_s lands inside the VOS spread, 0.2 dB below the foreach default. Any exact single-tensor or custom-kernel Adam pays the same cost. Bicycle/garden show no significant cost (VOS inside C0 twin noise on both).

gates_summary.C3_overhead_within_20pct_of_saving: PASS (fences+tau+nonzero amortized ~0.1 ms/iter vs 0.9-6.1 ms/iter saved)
gates_summary.quality: SSIM/LPIPS 3/3; PSNR 2/3 scenes inside twin noise, room attributed to the A_s envelope with a pure-torch control run

caveats: Room (smallest optimizer share, 17%) gains only +2.5% wall and shows the A_s-envelope quality cost (-0.2 dB mean vs foreach C0); on room the trade is marginal.

The VOS stage carries a per-iteration host sync (torch.nonzero) and is CPU-contention-sensitive; under 3-way co-tenancy the measured stage speedup deflated 1.66x -> 1.43x. A production integration would replace nonzero with a device-side compaction to remove this sensitivity.

n=2 pairs per scene (order A contended, order B GPU-exclusive); no multi-seed replication (protocol seed 42 frozen). The A_s-class arms show wider run-to-run quality spread (VOS twins 0.02-0.22 dB) than C0 twins (0.02-0.09 dB).
Scope is shs-only, 15001-30000; opacity virtualization (Phase-10) not attempted.
